overview.titleZh: GLP-1类多肽药物研究与放射性配体治疗进展
overview.summaryZh: 本期内容涵盖12条文献和3条行业新闻，核心集中在GLP-1类药物的临床前研究、临床安全性、市场动态与产业合作，以及放射性配体治疗在肿瘤诊断中的探索性研究。文献部分包括多个随机试验、综述和病例报告，行业新闻则聚焦于GLP-1药物的商业拓展。
themes: GLP-1受体激动剂多效性研究
口服与固定比例复方多肽药物
放射性配体治疗与诊断一体化

sections.summaryZh: 本期未收录公司与管线相关记录。
本期未收录临床与监管相关记录。
本期收录12条文献，主要涉及GLP-1药物的血糖、体重管理、肠促胰岛素反应、造血影响、安全性及MASH纤维化治疗，以及PSMA、SSTR靶向放射性配体治疗的临床研究或综述。
本期收录3条行业新闻，包括GLP-1在Medicare计划中的销售分析、美纳里尼与甘李的欧洲合作协议，以及Absci CEO的人物特写。

items.titleZh: 石榴汁与糖水在血糖反应上相似但肠促胰岛素反应不同：随机交叉试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机交叉试验比较了石榴汁与糖水对血糖和肠促胰岛素反应的影响。结果显示，两者诱导的血糖反应相似，但肠促胰岛素反应存在差异。该研究发表于《J Nutr》。

items.summaryZh: 这项单中心回顾性研究评估了生长抑素受体（SSTR）激动剂和拮抗剂PET示踪剂在乳腺癌中的阳性率。研究纳入37例乳腺癌患者，其中30例纳入最终分析。患者层面，80%的ER阳性乳腺癌和50%的三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）检测到SSTR阳性病灶。区域层面，ER阳性乳腺癌中60%的[18F]FDG阳性区域为SSTR阳性，TNBC中为33%。SSTR成像的平均SUVmax通常低于[18F]FDG。

items.originalTitle: SSTR-Targeted Radiotheranostics in Breast Cancer: A Comparison of [68Ga]Ga-DOTATOC and [68Ga]Ga-SSO120 with [18F]FDG PET
items.originalSummary: Somatostatin receptor (SSTR)-targeting radiotracers hold promise for theranostic applications in breast cancer (BC). This retrospective single-center study aimed to assess the proportion of SSTR-positive BC and its relevance for peptide receptor radionuclide therapy. SSTR-agonist- and SSTR-antagonist-based PET tracers are compared. Methods: Patients with BC who underwent PET imaging with SSTR agonist [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTATOC or SSTR antagonist [ 68 Ga]Ga-SSO120 (February 2023 to February 2025) for initial or follow-up staging were included. All patients underwent [ 18 F]FDG PET, which was used as the reference standard. Mean administered activities and uptake times were 88 MBq for 64 min with [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTATOC and 131 MBq for 66 min with [ 68 Ga]Ga-SSO120, respectively. PET-positive lesions were reported in 6 anatomic categories. Tumors were segmented; SUVs, tumor-to-liver ratios, and tumor volumes were calculated. Time to progression stratified by SSTR expression was assessed using the log-rank test. Results: In total, 37 patients with BC (26 estrogen-receptor [ER]-positive, 11 triple negative [TN]) were identified; final analysis was limited to 30 patients after excluding 7 with no detectable tumor. Most had metastatic disease (M1) at staging (26/36). On the patient level, SSTR-positive tumor ( 1 lesion) was detected in 80% of ER-positive BC (16/20) and in 50% of patients with TNBC (5/10). In ER-positive disease, positivity was comparable for [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTATOC (85%) and [ 68 Ga]Ga-SSO120 (71%), whereas in TNBC, positivity was observed with [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTATOC (83%) only. On the region level, 60% (31/52) of [ 18 F]FDG-positive regions in ER-positive BC and 33% (7/21) in TNBC were SSTR-positive. items.titleZh: [177Lu]Lu-PSMA-617与[177Lu]Lu-PSMA I&T的总生存期比较：倾向评分匹配的真实世界分析
items.summaryZh: 这项真实世界分析比较了[177Lu]Lu-PSMA-617和[177Lu]Lu-PSMA I&T在转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌患者中的临床结局。研究纳入140例化疗经治患者，每组70例，进行倾向评分匹配。结果显示，两组的中位总生存期相当（I&T：14个月；617：15个月；HR=1.18，P=0.42）。[177Lu]Lu-PSMA-617组的中位PSA下降更大（-58% vs. -14%），生化反应率更高（70% vs. 54%），但血液学毒性略有差异。

items.whyItMattersZh: 研究为临床决策提供了两种放射性配体疗法疗效对比的真实世界证据，但作为回顾性研究，存在选择偏倚，且缺少个体化剂量学数据，需谨慎解读。

items.originalTitle: Overall Survival with [177Lu]Lu-PSMA-617 Versus [177Lu]Lu-PSMA I&T: A Propensity Score-Matched Real-World Analysis
items.originalSummary: In this study, we compared clinical outcomes and safety profiles of radiopharmaceutical therapy with [ 177 Lu]Lu-PSMA-617 and [ 177 Lu]Lu-PSMA I&T in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer under real-world conditions. Methods: This single-center retrospective matched-pair analysis included 140 chemotherapy-pretreated patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer treated with commercially available [ 177 Lu]Lu-PSMA-617 (7.4 GBq every 6 wk) ( n = 70) or in-house produced [ 177 Lu]Lu-PSMA I&T (6.0 GBq every 8 wk) ( n = 70). Propensity score matching was performed on the basis of age, baseline prostate-specific antigen (PSA), and PSA-positive tumor volume and stratified by Gleason score. Overall survival (OS), biochemical response, prognostic factors, and treatment-related toxicity were analyzed. Results: Median OS was comparable between matched cohorts ([ 177 Lu]Lu-PSMA I&T: 14 mo; range, 9-16 mo; [ 177 Lu]Lu-PSMA-617: 15 mo; range, 10-21 mo); hazard ratio, 1.18; 95% CI, 0.79-1.78; P = 0.42). Early PSA response was strongly associated with prolonged OS in both cohorts ( P 177 Lu]Lu-PSMA-617 demonstrated a greater median PSA decline (-58% vs. -14%, P = 0.02) and higher biochemical response rates (70% vs. 54%). Although quantitative hematologic changes were more pronounced with [ 177 Lu]Lu-PSMA-617, Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events-graded toxicity remained comparable between cohorts. items.titleZh: [177Lu]Lu-AKIR001 用于 CD44v6 阳性胰腺癌的临床前疗效与联合策略
items.summaryZh: 该研究评估了靶向 CD44v6 的放射性药物 [177Lu]Lu-AKIR001 单独及联合化疗对胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）的治疗效果。结果显示，4 株细胞系中有 3 株表达 CD44v6，肿瘤摄取超过 100%IA/g；单药 12 MBq 剂量下 40% 完全缓解，联合紫杉醇（4 MBq）时 14% 完全缓解。结论表明该药物具有活性依赖性治疗潜力，联合治疗可能具有协同作用，但需进一步优化。
items.whatItIsZh: 这是一项临床前研究，通过 PDAC 细胞系和异种移植小鼠模型评估 [177Lu]Lu-AKIR001 的疗效与毒性。
items.whyItMattersZh: 该研究为 CD44v6 阳性胰腺癌的放射配体治疗提供了临床前证据，支持联合化疗的潜在协同策略；但证据仅来自动物模型，需更多优化研究。
keyPoints: 4 株 PDAC 细胞系中 3 株表达 CD44v6

items.originalTitle: [177Lu]Lu-AKIR001 for CD44v6-Positive Pancreatic Cancer: Preclinical Efficacy and Combination Strategies
items.originalSummary: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is highly aggressive, with a 5-y survival rate of less than 5% for patients with advanced disease. CD44v6 is frequently overexpressed in the malignancy, representing a promising therapeutic target. Here, we evaluated the efficacy of [ 177 Lu]Lu-AKIR001, a CD44v6-targeting radiopharmaceutical, alone and combined with chemotherapy for the treatment of PDAC. Methods: CD44v6 expression, radioligand binding, and chemotherapy sensitivity were assessed in PDAC cell lines. Mice bearing PDAC xenografts received [ 177 Lu]Lu-AKIR001, chemotherapy, or a combination of the two modalities. Toxicity was determined by body weight monitoring and hematologic and organ analyses. Results: Three of the 4 cell lines expressed CD44v6. In vivo, tumor uptake exceeded 100 %IA/g. Tumor growth inhibition was activity-dependent, with complete remissions detected after the administration of 12 MBq of [ 177 Lu]Lu-AKIR001 (40%) and 4 MBq of [ 177 Lu]Lu-AKIR001 combined with paclitaxel (14%). Conclusion: [ 177 Lu]Lu-AKIR001 demonstrated activity-dependent therapeutic potential in mice bearing PDAC xenografts. Combination therapy with paclitaxel indicated potential synergistic benefit, but further investigation and optimization are warranted.

items.titleZh: MIRD 手册第 34 号第 2 部分：MIRDct 软件用于 CT 器官剂量估算的基准测试
items.summaryZh: 该研究系统评估了基于网格模型的 CT 剂量计算软件 MIRDct，与参考软件 NCICT 和 VirtualDose 在多种扫描仪、体模和协议下的器官吸收剂量和有效剂量一致性。结果显示，CTDIvol 值中位差异不超过 7%，野内器官剂量系数差异通常在 25% 以内。

items.originalTitle: MIRD Pamphlet No. 34, Part 2: Benchmarking of MIRDct Software for CT Organ Dose Estimation
items.originalSummary: Accurate estimation of organ and effective doses in CT imaging is essential for risk assessment, protocol optimization, and personalized care in diagnostic radiology and nuclear medicine. We systematically benchmarked MIRDct, a freely available mesh phantom-based CT dose calculation software, against established reference software (National Cancer Institute Dosimetry System for Computed Tomography [NCICT] and VirtualDose [Virtual Phantoms]) by evaluating agreement between organ-absorbed doses and effective doses across representative scanners, phantoms, and protocols. Methods: Organ absorbed and effective doses were calculated for adult and pediatric phantoms for whole-body (WB) and regional (head, chest, abdomen-pelvis [AP]) CT examinations. MIRDct uses mesh-based International Commission on Radiologic Protection (ICRP) reference phantoms with anatomically realistic organ surfaces, whereas NCICT and VirtualDose use voxel-based ICRP 110 and hybrid Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute/University of Florida phantom models, respectively. For each software, volumetric CT dose index (CTDIvol) values were obtained from the software interface using matched acquisition parameters; in MIRDct, these values were derived from scanner console-reported outputs for the corresponding protocol settings. Organ absorbed doses, dose coefficients, and effective doses were computed across 44 matched scanner-phantom-protocol configurations. Inter-software differences were summarized using medians and interquartile ranges. For regional protocols, organ-absorbed doses were stratified by irradiation category (in-field, partial-in-field, out-of-field), to assess field-dependent variability. Results: CTDIvol values reported by the 3 software tools showed close agreement across matched protocol configurations, with median inter-software differences not exceeding 7%. items.titleZh: 特朗普 GLP-1 更新：分析师暗示米里制药 Medicare 计划年销售额可达重磅
items.summaryZh: 作为特朗普政府与礼来和诺和诺德签署的最惠国药品定价协议的一部分，Medicare 推出了一项“桥接”模式，为符合条件的老年人提供每月 50 美元的减肥药。目前该计划的初始接纳数据已公布，分析师据此推断这可能为礼来带来重磅年度销售额。
items.whatItIsZh: 这是一则行业新闻，报道了 Medicare 新计划下 GLP-1 药物的初步使用情况及其对礼来销售潜力的影响。
items.whyItMattersZh: 该新闻反映了 GLP-1 药物在 Medicare 市场的定价和需求动态，可能影响产业销售收入；但来源是新闻和分析师评论，需以官方报告为准。
keyPoints: 每月 50 美元的价格
Medicare 启动桥接计划
分析师暗示礼来可能获得重磅年销售额
items.originalTitle: Trump GLP-1 update teases blockbuster annual sales for Lilly from Medicare program: analyst
items.originalSummary: As part of the MFN drug pricing deal the Trump administration signed with obesity giants Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk, Medicare recently launched a “bridge” model, offering weight loss drugs to eligible seniors at $50 per month. Now, we know the initial uptake from the program.

items.titleZh: 美纳里尼签订 7.71 亿美元协议，将甘李 GLP-1 引入欧洲市场
items.summaryZh: 意大利美纳里尼集团已同意支付中国胰岛素制造商甘李制药 6200 万欧元（约 7200 万美元）首付款，以合作注册和商业化甘李的 GLP-1 药物 bofanglutide。
items.whatItIsZh: 这是一笔商业交易新闻，涉及美纳里尼与甘李制药就 GLP-1 药物在欧洲市场的合作。
items.whyItMattersZh: 该交易显示了 GLP-1 类药物在欧洲市场的商业化机会，可能影响相关公司布局；但具体条款和里程碑付款细节未完全披露。
keyPoints: 首付款 6200 万欧元（约 7200 万美元）
合作内容为注册和商业化
药物为 GLP-1 bofanglutide
items.originalTitle: Menarini signs $771M deal to take Gan & Lee GLP-1 to European market
items.originalSummary: Italian company the Menarini Group has agreed to pay Chinese insulin maker Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals €62 million ($72 million) up front to collaborate on the registration and commercialization of Gan & Lee’s GLP-1 bofanglutide.

items.titleZh: 从父母地下室到你的药柜：Absci 首席执行官努力打造生物技术界的苹果
items.summaryZh: GLP-1 减肥药物的巨大需求重塑了药品市场，使消费者能掌控自身健康，消除了钱包与药柜之间的障碍。文章介绍了 Absci 首席执行官的个人背景及其创建生物技术领域标杆公司的愿景。
items.whatItIsZh: 这是一则人物特写新闻，聚焦 Absci 首席执行官的战略愿景和 GLP-1 市场影响。
items.whyItMattersZh: 内容体现了 GLP-1 药物对消费者和产业生态的广泛影响，但属于观点性报道，需谨慎解读为公司实际战略。
keyPoints: GLP-1 需求已重塑药品市场
消除消费者与药物之间的障碍
文章提及 Absci 领导层意图
items.originalTitle: From his parents’ basement to your medicine cabinet: Absci CEO endeavors to create biotech’s Apple
items.originalSummary: The overwhelming demand for GLP-1 weight loss drugs has reshaped the drug market, empowering consumers to take charge of their own health and removing barriers between their wallets and their medicine cabinets.
